title: Ask for More Specific Information
summary: Use the question forms Kilès, Kilè, and Poukisa to ask which, when, and why.

sketchBlocks.title: Kilès?
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
Use **Kilès?** to ask **which?**

For example:

**Kilès ladan yo?** — Which one of them?

Focus on **Kilès** as the new question for choosing one from a group.

segments.text: as the new question for choosing one from a group

tryItExercises.title: Choose the question form
tryItExercises.hint: Compare the information requested by each form.

help.concept: One form asks a learner to select one from a group.
help.hint_1: Look for the form associated with choosing among alternatives.
help.hint_2: Do not choose the form for time or reason.

sketchBlocks.title: Kilè?
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
Use **Kilè?** to ask **when?**

For example:

**Kilè ou prale?** — When will you go?

Use this question when you want to ask when something will happen.

segments.text: Use this question when you want to ask when something will happen

tryItExercises.title: Complete the when question
tryItExercises.prompt: Choose The question form that completes the example.
tryItExercises.hint: The missing word asks for when something will happen.

help.concept: Choose the form that requests time information rather than a reason or a choice.
help.hint_1: Read the rest of the sentence before selecting the question word.
help.hint_2: The answer would tell when the person will go.

sketchBlocks.title: Poukisa?
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
Use **Poukisa?** to ask **why?**

For example:

**Poukisa ou ap kriye?** — Why are you crying?

The reading section later uses the same form:

**Poukisa Kintola pa ale lekòl jodia?**

This topic focuses on the new information questions that extend what you learned in Course 1.

segments.text: The reading section later uses the same form
